[EN] Kill that argon!
[ES] ¡Mata a ese argon!

[EN] There was an argon at Skyfields? Do you think they've come back? If they have, we'll be lucky to live long enough to evacuate."There was only one. A shaper."
[ES] ¿Había un argon en Skyfields? ¿Crees que han vuelto? Si es así, tendremos suerte si vivimos lo suficiente para evacuar."There was only one. A shaper."

[EN] A shaper? Perhaps it was monitoring the argonomorphs. Then again, perhaps it was scouting an invasion route.

I'd better write this up.

Stay alert out there, .
[ES] ¿Un shaper? Tal vez estaba vigilando a los argonomorphs. O tal vez estaba explorando una ruta de invasión.

Será mejor que escriba esto.

Mantente alerta ahí fuera, .
